title: Present Perfect
intro:
Present perfect: have/has + past participle (bentuk ketiga). Dipakai untuk pengalaman dan hal yang baru selesai. Kata bantunya already, just, never, ever, dan yet.
I have eaten.
She has gone.
They have just arrived.

exercises.question: She ___ her homework.
exercises.explanation: He, she, dan it memakai has. Setelahnya past participle: finished.

exercises.question: We ___ that movie already.
exercises.explanation: 'We' memakai have. Past participle dari see adalah seen, bukan saw.

exercises.prompt: Complete the sentence with the present perfect
exercises.explanation: Have + past participle. Bentuk ketiga dari eat adalah eaten.

exercises.prompt: Complete the sentence with the present perfect
exercises.explanation: 'He' memakai has, dan bentuk ketiga dari write adalah written.

exercises.prompt: Match each verb to its past participle
exercises.explanation: Past participle adalah bentuk ketiga: go jadi gone, eat jadi eaten, see jadi seen, do jadi done, write jadi written.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order
exercises.explanation: Subjek + have + never + past participle. Kata never diletakkan di antara have dan kata kerja.

exercises.question: Pick the correct present perfect sentence.
exercises.explanation: 'They' memakai have, dan bentuk ketiga dari go adalah gone, bukan went.
Present perfect: has + past participle. Bentuk ketiga dari take adalah taken.

exercises.task: Write one sentence about something you have done today.
exercises.modelAnswer: I have finished my homework today.
exercises.explanation: Gunakan have/has + past participle, misalnya 'I have finished my homework today.'
